sites.name: Udzungwa Mountains
sites.location: Udzungwa Mountains National Park, Morogoro & Iringa regions
sites.summary: Rainforest peaks and waterfalls at the heart of the Eastern Arc – a global biodiversity hotspot and essential stop for forest endemics and primate-rich birding.
whyItMatters: Part of the ancient Eastern Arc Mountains, often called the “Galápagos of Africa” for exceptional levels of endemism.
Misty escarpment forests isolate populations that evolved into species found nowhere else on Earth.
Sanje Falls trails and forest walks give unhurried time for skulkers, mixed-species flocks and photographic forest light.
sites.generalNotes: Gateway forests on many southern endemic birding routes between Mikumi, Ruaha and the Kilombero floodplain.

sites.name: Ukaguru Mountains
sites.summary: Remote Eastern Arc block east of the Rubeho–Uluguru chain – low-traffic montane forest birding for travellers who want quiet forest endemics.
whyItMatters: One of the least-visited Eastern Arc ranges, with intact forest patches that still hold arc endemics.
Ideal for listers combining southern parks with arc forest targets without the crowds of northern circuits.
Important Important Bird Area (IBA) connectivity between Uluguru, Rubeho and Udzungwa forests.
sites.generalNotes: Access and timing are route-specific; we plan Ukaguru as a focused forest extension on tailor-made southern endemic itineraries.

sites.name: Mikumi National Park
sites.location: Morogoro Region · Southern / Mikumi highway corridor
sites.summary: Open Mkata floodplain and miombo-fringed hills – reliable savanna birding en route to Udzungwa and Ruaha with 400+ recorded species.
whyItMatters: Year-round wildlife and birding on the main southern corridor – perfect first stop after Dar es Salaam or Morogoro.
Mkata plain mirrors classic East African savanna while miombo slopes add different guilds in a single park.
Strong complement to forest days in Udzungwa and wilderness days in Ruaha on one southern circuit.
sites.generalNotes: Hippo pools and baobab-lined plains are standard birding stops on Endemic Birds southern routes.

sites.name: Ruaha National Park
sites.summary: Vast miombo wilderness where East African savanna meets southern Africa – world-renowned for Ruaha Red-billed Hornbill and miombo specialists.
whyItMatters: One of the few places where East and South meet ecologically – unique hornbill taxonomy and miombo bird communities.
Ruaha Red-billed Hornbill is recognised from this landscape and is a must for serious southern listers.
Huge, remote country means quiet roads, riverine gullies and baobab studded ridges – excellent for photographers.
sites.generalNotes: Based in Iringa, Endemic Birds treats Ruaha as a core southern endemic and wildlife anchor.

sites.name: Uluti Mountain
sites.displayNameNote: Listed on endemicbirds.co.tz; corresponds to the Uluguru massif above Morogoro (Eastern Arc).
sites.location: Morogoro Region · Uluguru Mountains, Eastern Arc
sites.summary: Green Uluguru escarpments rising above Morogoro – montane forest, Choma waterfalls and arc endemics on the southern/eastern birding corridor.
whyItMatters: Uluguru forests are a global biodiversity hotspot with dozens of plants and animals found nowhere else.
Water catchment forests feed the Ruvu system and hold montane species at accessible day-hike or multi-day altitudes.
Natural pairing with Mikumi savanna and Udzungwa forest on combined southern–Eastern Arc itineraries.
sites.generalNotes: We use the Uluti listing name from the live site menu; field routes target Uluguru forest and village trails from Morogoro.

sites.name: Rubeho Mountains
sites.location: Morogoro & Dodoma regions · Eastern Arc Mountains
sites.summary: High, little-visited Eastern Arc range – forest endemics including Rubeho Akalat and Rubeho Warbler for dedicated arc listers.
whyItMatters: Named for endemic birds restricted to these forests – a priority for world listers completing the Eastern Arc suite.
Connects the Uluguru–Ukaguru forests with the Udzungwa block for landscape-scale conservation.
Low tourism footprint means authentic forest birding when access and season align.
sites.generalNotes: Typically combined with Morogoro-area arc sites on advanced southern endemic routes – logistics confirmed per departure.

sites.name: Nyerere National Park
sites.location: Southern Tanzania · Rufiji River basin (former Selous core)
sites.summary: Africa’s largest national park – vast miombo, Rufiji rivers and lakes with wild dogs, elephants and rich riparian birding on the southern circuit.
whyItMatters: UNESCO-scale wilderness now branded Nyerere – boat safaris on the Rufiji unlock species rare elsewhere in the south.
Wild dog and elephant stronghold with excellent raptor and hornbill viewing in miombo.
Natural complement to Ruaha and coastal extensions on extended southern itineraries.
sites.generalNotes: Formerly marketed as Selous Game Reserve; boat and foot safari options shape birding access.

sites.name: Rondo Plateau
sites.location: Lindi Region · Coastal Eastern Arc forest
sites.summary: Remnant coastal forest on the Rondo Plateau – Rondo endemic birds and lowland forest specialists at the southern edge of the Eastern Arc.
whyItMatters: One of the most isolated Eastern Arc forest islands – unique species assemblage for dedicated listers.
Pairs with Kilombero and Udzungwa blocks on south-east endemic routes.
Low traffic compared to Usambara or Udzungwa – authentic forest listening.
sites.generalNotes: Access via Lindi / Mbwawa; typically a targeted extension on southeast birding departures.

sites.name: Kilombero Plains
sites.summary: Vast seasonal floodplain and wetland mosaic – global stronghold for Kilombero endemics where the river meets miombo and grassland.
whyItMatters: Among Tanzania’s most important IBAs for range-restricted wetland birds.
Essential stop between Udzungwa forests and southern miombo on endemic-focused routes.
Open plains and swamp edges allow scope views after dense forest days.
sites.generalNotes: Ifunga and Kilombero valley access is planned with local guides on Iringa–Morogoro birding weeks.
